request.query: Evaluating the diagonal specialization of a multivariate polynomial at x equals evaluating the original polynomial with every variable equal to x

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval_toMvPolynomial
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : σ → R) (i : σ) (p : Polynomial R),
  (MvPolynomial.eval f) ((Polynomial.toMvPolynomial i) p) = Polynomial.eval (f i) p

items.name: Polynomial.eval_C_X_eval₂_map_C_X
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {p : Polynomial (Polynomial R)},
  Polynomial.eval (Polynomial.C Polynomial.X)
      (Polynomial.eval₂ (Polynomial.mapRingHom (algebraMap R (Polynomial (Polynomial R)))) (Polynomial.C Polynomial.X)
        p) =
    p

items.name: MvPolynomial.evalₗ
items.type: (K : Type u_1) → (σ : Type u_2) → [inst : CommSemiring K] → MvPolynomial σ K →ₗ[K] (σ → K) → K

items.name: Polynomial.eval
items.type: {R : Type u} → [inst : Semiring R] → R → Polynomial R → R

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval_comp_toMvPolynomial
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : σ → R) (i : σ),
  (MvPolynomial.eval f).comp ↑(Polynomial.toMvPolynomial i) = Polynomial.evalRingHom (f i)
